title: Assumption-contrast inquiry
statement: For a consequential product decision bounded by authored possibilities, an agent can express competing assumption scenarios, project which visible candidates depend on each assumption, identify unassessed candidates and shared-assumption groups, and use the contrast to discover or evaluate a materially different direction without automatic generation or ranking.

alignment.basis: ADR 0037's domain-general cognitive development and the active agent's ownership of semantic judgment support assumption-aware prospective reasoning.

ambition.basis: Would let an agent challenge the premises that bound its option set and discover an unrepresented direction, rather than only retrieve or recombine authored candidates.

horizon.basis: Existing possibility records, one-hop ecology relationships, the new contrast operation and a portable procedure supply the pieces; independent use is unobserved.

realization.basis: The underlying read-only contrast and procedure exist at 13bc8a2f, but this newly synthesized candidate has no independent later-agent use, decision outcome or comparative evidence. It remains hypothetical; no realization is claimed.

synthesis_basis: Contrast of goal:compounding-product-knowledge and goal:domain-general-cognitive-development showed five direct candidates and nine descendant candidates with only three authored assumptions; five candidates were unassessed, two had partial relationship coverage, and shared assumptions lacked direct relations. The existing assumption-aware candidate itself had no authored assumptions. A focused scenario-conditioned contrast plus a portable procedure is distinct from a broad opportunity generator and reuses existing authored possibility records.
value_hypothesis: A later agent can challenge the assumptions that bound its option set, discover unrepresented combinations, and avoid building on an unexamined premise without automatic generation or ranking.
revisit_when: An authentic decision uses the contrast to change or confirm a construction direction, and a later agent evaluates whether it reduced missed alternatives or false assumptions.
counterevidence: The existing possibility-ecology already exposes one-hop assumptions, so the contrast may be a procedure and presentation layer rather than a new capability. The visible candidate set is small, two candidates have partial relationship coverage, and one same-agent use does not establish benefit.
claim_ceiling: Agent-authored hypothesis with an implemented read-only contrast and portable procedure. No independent later-agent use, decision benefit, comparative advantage or authorization is established.
